grounding.states: TSX is closed today, Monday Oct 12, 2026, for Thanksgiving; resumes Tuesday Oct 13
grounding.from: TMX Group said the Toronto Stock Exchange, TSX Venture Exchange, TSX Alpha Exchange and Montréal Exchange are closed Monday, October 12, 2026 for the Thanksgiving holiday. Regular trading resumes Tuesday, October 13.

grounding.states: S&P/TSX composite closed Friday Oct 9 at 35,664.62, up 519.24 points (about 1.48%)
grounding.from: The S&P/TSX composite index was up 519.24 points at 35,664.62 (BNN Bloomberg/Canadian Press). That is a gain of about 1.48%. TMX Money and Yahoo Finance show the same close.

value.answer: Markets are closed today for Thanksgiving, so no TSX trading. Last Friday (Oct 9) it closed at 35,664.62, up about 1.5% on the day. It reopens tomorrow, Tuesday the 13th.
